records.title: Expansion of ESIC Medical Facilities in Tamil Nadu
details: a to e: To cater to the increasing number of insured workers, ESIC has approved enhancement of bed strength of ESIC Medical College & Hospital KK Nagar, Chennai from 550 to 1000 beds in 2023.

records.title: ESIC HOSPITALS IN TAMIL NADU.
details: a to b: "in principle" approval for setting up of 7 new hospitals in Tamil Nadu. The details of 7 new hospitals and fund allocated are in Annexure.

records.title: Training Programme For AWWs
details: (a) to (c): Further, Government has also decided to upgrade all Mini AWCs with one worker to full-fledged Anganwadi Centres with one worker and one helper each.
